statements: A customer must be able to close their account. Add closeAccount(store, userId, now) to src/accounts.mjs.
Do whatever closing an account means for this company, and make sure everything else in the service behaves correctly afterwards.
An unknown user id throws the usual not-found error. Closing an account twice is harmless.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add account closing to the accounts service, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and repository and change only what the ticket needs.
